local({
  e97 <- lookup_values(
    as.numeric(CHRACE),
    lookup_ethnicity,
    dataset_id = spec$dataset_id,
    target_variable = "ethnicity"
  )
  e97 <- if_else(e97 == "Unknown", NA_character_, e97)
  recs <- sapply(1:4, function(k) {
    h <- as.numeric(coalesce(tbl[[paste0("X14HISP", k)]], tbl[[paste0("X19HISP", k)]]))
    r1 <- as.numeric(coalesce(tbl[[paste0("X14RAC1", k)]], tbl[[paste0("X19RAC1", k)]]))
    r2 <- as.numeric(coalesce(tbl[[paste0("X14RAC2", k)]], tbl[[paste0("X19RAC2", k)]]))
    rv <- recode_values(
      r1,
      1 ~ "White",
      2 ~ "Black",
      3 ~ "Other",
      4 ~ "Asian",
      5 ~ "Other",
      7 ~ "Other",
      default = NA_character_
    )
    rv <- if_else(r2 %in% c(1:5, 7) & r2 != r1 & !is.na(rv), "Mixed", rv)
    case_when(h %in% 1:7 ~ "Hispanic", h %in% c(0, 8) ~ rv, .default = NA_character_)
  })
  obs <- coalesce(e97, apply(recs, 1, function(r) r[!is.na(r)][1]))
  eth <- carry_within(obs, participant_id, order = as.numeric(.wave))
  coalesce(eth, "Unknown")
})
notes: Original cohort: PCG report of the child's race and Hispanic origin in one item (CHRACE, 1997; White non-Hispanic, Black non-Hispanic, Hispanic, Asian or Pacific Islander, American Indian or Alaskan Native, Other) through the shared ethnicity lookup, carried to 2002 and 2007; no multiracial option, so Mixed cannot be recorded (proximate). CDS-2014 generation: the child's Hispanicity and up to three race mentions from the parents' PSID Childbirth and Adoption History records (birth mother first, then birth father, adoptive mother, adoptive father; X14/X19HISPk, RAC1k, RAC2k): any Hispanic origin = Hispanic, then two different race mentions = Mixed, else the race (American Indian or Alaska Native and Native Hawaiian or Pacific Islander = Other); a Hispanicity code 8 (DK, or a record collected before Hispanicity was asked in 2005, when Latin origin was a race code now carried as Hispanicity 6) is read as not Hispanic where a race is recorded. Observed waves keep their value; 2020 and other missing waves take the earliest observed (carry-forward rule).

local({
  r_new <- coalesce(as.numeric(X14PCGRLSP), as.numeric(X19PCGRLSP))
  mother <- r_new %in% c(1, 2, 3, 9, 27)
  pm <- coalesce(as.numeric(H14IWAGE), as.numeric(H19IWAGE))
  pm <- if_else(pm > 0 & pm < 1200, pm / 12, NA_real_)

    .wave == "2020",
    carry_within(gap19, participant_id, order = as.numeric(.wave)) + as.numeric(P20AGEX) + 0.5,
    NA_real_
  )
  coalesce(observed, proj20)
})

local({
  m <- sapply(tbl[grep("^X(14|19|21)R[0-9]{2}RTC$", names(tbl))], as.numeric)
  has <- rowSums(!is.na(m)) > 0
  mo <- rowSums(matrix(m %in% c(1, 3), nrow = nrow(m)))
  fa <- rowSums(matrix(m %in% c(4, 6), nrow = nrow(m)))
  st <- rowSums(matrix(m %in% c(2, 5, 9, 10), nrow = nrow(m)))
  new <- case_when(
    !has ~ NA_character_,
    mo >= 1 & fa >= 1 ~ "Two biological/adoptive parents",
    mo + fa >= 1 & st >= 1 ~ "Step family",
    mo + fa >= 1 ~ "Single parent",
    .default = "Other"
  )
  bio <- as.numeric(coalesce(BIOPR97, BIOPR01, BIOPR07))
  ocg <- as.numeric(coalesce(RELOCG97, RELOCG02, RELOCG07))
  pcg <- as.numeric(coalesce(RELPCG97, RELPCG02, RELPCG07))
  old <- case_when(
    bio == 1 ~ "Two biological/adoptive parents",
    pcg %in% c(3, 6) & ocg %in% c(1, 3, 4, 6) ~ "Two biological/adoptive parents",
    bio %in% c(2, 3) & ocg %in% c(2, 5, 9, 10) ~ "Step family",
    bio %in% c(2, 3) ~ "Single parent",
    bio %in% c(4, 5) & pcg %in% c(3, 6) ~ "Single parent",
    bio %in% c(4, 5) ~ "Other",
    .default = NA_character_
  )
  coalesce(new, old, "Unknown")
})
notes: 2014-2020: the household roster's relationship of each member to the child (X14/X19/X21RnnRTC): a biological or adoptive mother and father = Two biological/adoptive parents; one of them with a step-parent or a parent's cohabiting partner = Step family; one with neither = Single parent; neither = Other (grandparents, foster care, step-parent only). 2020 rows use the roster the tidier carried from the 2019 or 2021 coverscreen within 12 months, else Unknown. 1997-2007: the study's constructed coresidence of the biological parents in the PSID family unit (BIOPR97, BIOPR01 for 2002 from the 2001 family file, BIOPR07) with the PCG's and other caregiver's relationships to the child: both biological parents (or two adoptive caregivers) = Two biological/adoptive parents; one biological parent with a step-parent or partner as other caregiver = Step family; one biological parent otherwise = Single parent; no biological parent = Other (an adoptive PCG alone = Single parent). Proximate: 1997-2007 cannot separate a single parent from one whose partner gave no other-caregiver interview, so such homes count as Single parent.
